title: Crystal Processing Table
text: The crystal processing table writes low-tier spell crystals.

The upper-left target microcore is required; the upper-right shape modifier is optional. The left slots hold modifiers and the right slots hold elements, all optional. Add ink and a spiritual crystal in the center, then begin writing.
The base cost is 10 mana per spell component, followed by cost reductions. Ink and the substrate do not count as components.
